Lesson of Brambles.name: Lesson of Brambles
Lesson of Brambles.description: You must be ready to defend yourself from any who would dare harm you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.PB5cKSpPFeShAcJV]{Coiling Creepers} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KsWhliKfUs3IpW3c]{Wall of Thorns}.

Lesson of Destiny.name: Lesson of Destiny
Lesson of Destiny.description: This is what you were always meant to do. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.nLPIv4DdLPDDu6N7]{Unleash True Power} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AuIiqc7jjiy1GZ75]{Manifestation}.

Lesson of Legacy.name: Lesson of Legacy
Lesson of Legacy.description: You were not the first witch in servitude to your patron. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.DZtgq345ra0HZtg8]{Secret of the Forebearers} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hghGRzOSzEl4UXdS]{Invoke Spirits}.

Lesson of Mirrors.name: Lesson of Mirrors
Lesson of Mirrors.description: The world on the other side of the mirror has many secrets from which you can learn from. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.RvEtKvWzlGlnCFNk]{Specular Portals} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A7w3YQBrFNH8KYsB]{Mirror's Misfortune}.

Lesson of Apocalypses.name: Lesson of Apocalypses
Lesson of Apocalypses.description: The end of the world will come in exactly the way foreseen by your patron. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.dtRMSLa2GJK6XPM0]{Patron's Apocalypse} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wLIvH0AT1u7oa64N]{Cataclysm}.

Lesson of Senses.name: Lesson of Senses
Lesson of Senses.description: Trust your senses—and if you cannot, then you must adapt. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.hPimFSXw5UxmDCFN]{Sensory Deprivation} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}.

Lesson of Nightmares.name: Lesson of Nightmares
Lesson of Nightmares.description: The power of dreams is great, but the horrors of a nightmare are even greater. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.XPEKWkreDnAMJoul]{Eternal Slumber} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.U58aQWJ47VrI36yP]{Hallucination}.

Lesson of Prophecy.name: Lesson of Prophecy
Lesson of Prophecy.description: Gaze into the main futures and pluck one from the streams of time. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.zqHHwUxFcbdFvTzW]{Soothsayer's Prediction} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EUMjrJJwSgsqNidi]{Anticipate Peril}.

Lesson of Disease.name: Lesson of Disease
Lesson of Disease.description: The smallest virus can topple the largest dragon. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.J76UyZrMV8XdyIKa]{Sudden Outbreak} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zJQnkKEKbJqGB3iB]{Goblin Pox}.

Lesson of Aging.name: Lesson of Aging
Lesson of Aging.description: All that is ugly is beautiful, and all that is beautiful is ugly; those who fail to recognize this are naught but fools. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.5IxpPxEQWsoha7Gx]{Warped Visage} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MNiT0dHol5fEcKlz]{Threefold Aspect}.

Lesson of Studiousness.name: Lesson of Studiousness
Lesson of Studiousness.description: Keen understanding of the lessons of your patron will take your far. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.tM0BhVmf8Ylz4f2G]{Brief Lesson} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TjWHgXqPv5jywMti]{Pocket Library}.

Lesson of Judgement.name: Lesson of Judgement
Lesson of Judgement.description: Your patron has granted you the role of final arbitrator, deciding who lives and who dies. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.pj7DPwmlbWWqe1Un]{Judge Soul} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ckUOoqOM7Kg7VqxB]{Avatar}.

Lesson of Sigils.name: Lesson of Sigils
Lesson of Sigils.description: Anciest runes and markings hold impossible power. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.YFusnK3S1rkhfy55]{Holding Glyph} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DgcSiOCR1uDXGaEA]{Synchronize}.

Lesson of Binding.name: Lesson of Binding
Lesson of Binding.description: Extraplanar beings make the greatest of assistants... if you only know how to keep them by your side. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.A3321ycmFdKzgoNO]{Binding Summon} hex, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GUeRTriJkMlMlVrk]{Bind Undead}.
